method: Complete 0.5-second visual review of 4920-4980; additional 0.125-second review of 4923-4927, 4952-4957 and 4977-4981. Assistant-reviewed, not independently verified by a human coach. Unresolved 4920-4927 remains in the preregistered cohort, NOT labeled negative or discarded.
definition: Visible live-ball field-goal attempts including blocked attempts; free throws excluded. Duration includes ordinary dead balls and inbound preparation, not exclusively live-ball time.
split: expansion frozen before any algorithm run on this time range; same game as previous splits, NOT a new-game holdout; zero-shot negative interval does not by itself measure shot recall

黑衣推进、外围传球和远侧切入，球员低位收球受阻后停表，未见向篮筐投射。
死球、换人及底线发球准备；普通场内流程而非广告/长暂停。
